GenericAssetUploadRequest.description:
Serializer for generic asset upload requests with project association.

Validates metadata for generating presigned URLs for workspace assets including
project association, external system tracking, and file validation for
document management and content storage workflows.

project_id.description: UUID of the project to associate with the asset

external_id.description: External identifier for the asset (for integration tracking)

GitCodeReviewLink.description: Read serializer for a Git provider code review linked to a work item.

GithubPullRequestLink.description:
Read serializer for a GitHub PR linked to a work item.

All PR-status fields are server-managed (set at attach time and refreshed by
the GitHub App webhook), so the client only ever supplies ``url`` on create.

IntakeIssue.description:
Comprehensive serializer for intake work items with expanded issue details.

Provides full intake work item data including embedded issue information,
status tracking, and triage metadata for issue queue management.

IntakeIssueCreateRequest.description:
Serializer for creating intake work items with embedded issue data.

Manages intake work item creation including nested issue creation,
status assignment, and source tracking for issue queue management.

issue.description: Issue data for the intake issue

Issue.description:
Comprehensive work item serializer with full relationship management.

Handles complete work item lifecycle including assignees, labels, validation,
and related model updates. Supports dynamic field expansion and HTML content
processing.

agent_executor.description:

* `cloud_agent` - Pi Dash Cloud Agent

IssueActivity.description:
Serializer for work item activity and change history.

Tracks and represents work item modifications, state changes,
and user interactions for audit trails and activity feeds.

IssueAdvancedSearchResult.description:
One match from the CLI / agent-oriented work-item search endpoint.

Shape is optimized for agents / pi-dash CLI consumption: composed
human identifier (PROJ-42), a plain-text snippet around the match, a
relevance score, and the timestamps needed to reason about chronology.

snippet.description: Plain-text excerpt of description_stripped around the match

url.description: Absolute, human-clickable web URL for the issue. Omitted when no deployment web base URL (WEB_URL / APP_BASE_URL) is configured.

IssueAttachment.description:
Serializer for work item file attachments.

Manages file asset associations with work items including metadata,
storage information, and access control for document management.

IssueAttachmentUploadRequest.description:
Serializer for work item attachment upload request validation.

Handles file upload metadata validation including size, type, and external
integration tracking for secure work item document attachment workflows.

external_id.description: External identifier for the asset (for integration tracking)

IssueComment.description:
Full serializer for work item comments with membership context.

Provides complete comment data including member status, content formatting,
and edit tracking for collaborative work item discussions.

IssueCommentCreateRequest.description:
Serializer for creating work item comments.

Handles comment creation with JSON and HTML content support,
access control, and external integration tracking.

IssueExpand.description:

labels, assignees, and states for comprehensive data representation.

IssueForIntakeRequest.description:

Handles essential work item fields for intake processing including
content validation and priority assignment for triage workflows.

IssueLink.description:
Full serializer for work item external links.

Provides complete link information including metadata and timestamps
for managing external resource associations with work items.

IssueLinkCreateRequest.description:
Serializer for creating work item external links with validation.

Handles URL validation, format checking, and duplicate prevention
for attaching external resources to work items.

IssueRelation.description:
Serializer for issue relationships showing related issue details.

Provides comprehensive information about related issues including
project context, sequence ID, and relationship type.

IssueRelationCreateRequest.description:
Serializer for creating issue relations.

Creates issue relations with the specified relation type and issues.
Validates relation types and ensures proper issue ID format.

relation_type.description:
Type of relationship between work items

* `blocking` - Blocking
* `blocked_by` - Blocked By
* `duplicate` - Duplicate
* `relates_to` - Relates To
* `start_before` - Start Before
* `start_after` - Start After
* `finish_before` - Finish Before
* `finish_after` - Finish After

issues.description: Array of work item IDs to create relations with

IssueRelationResponse.description:
Serializer for issue relations response showing grouped relation types.

Returns issue IDs organized by relation type for efficient client-side processing.

blocking.description: List of issue IDs that are blocking this issue

blocked_by.description: List of issue IDs that this issue is blocked by

duplicate.description: List of issue IDs that are duplicates of this issue

relates_to.description: List of issue IDs that relate to this issue

start_after.description: List of issue IDs that start after this issue

start_before.description: List of issue IDs that start before this issue

finish_after.description: List of issue IDs that finish after this issue

finish_before.description: List of issue IDs that finish before this issue

Validates work item ID lists for batch operations including
module assignment and work item organization workflows.

Lightweight module serializer for minimal data transfer.

Provides essential module information without computed metrics,
optimized for list views and reference lookups.

PageDetail.description:
One page, with its body in all three renderings.

``description_markdown`` is derived, not stored: it is produced on read by
:func:`pi_dash.utils.markdown_converter.html_to_markdown` so the API, the
CLI and the MCP connector never disagree about how a page reads.

PageLite.description:
Page metadata only — no body.

Used by the list endpoint: a project wiki can hold long documents, and an
agent listing pages wants the index, not every body at once.

SchedulerAPI.description:
A workspace scheduler definition, with the bindings the caller may see.

``bindings`` reads the ``visible_bindings`` attribute the view attaches
(via ``Prefetch(..., to_attr="visible_bindings")``), so the workspace
list never leaks installs on projects the caller is not a member of.

SchedulerRunAPI.description:
One scheduler-fired agent run, for the run-history endpoint.

``issues`` is the audit trail of work items the run wrote to: every
issue carrying a comment whose ``speaker_agent_run_id`` is this run.
The view precomputes the mapping in one query and passes it through
``context["issues_by_run"]``.
